responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/solve/delegate.rs: Implements the adapter between `rustc_trait_selection`'s `InferCtxt` and the generic next trait solver delegate interface, exposing the inference, canonicalization, opaque-type, const-evaluation, region-constraint, specialization, and transmutability operations that solver queries need to read or mutate compiler state. compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/solve/fulfill.rs: Defines the new-solver fulfillment engine used by trait selection code to accumulate predicate obligations, repeatedly evaluate and requeue them, preserve overflowed obligations, invoke proof-tree inspection hooks, and translate solver outcomes into `TraitEngine` errors and diagnostics-oriented obligation causes. compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/solve/inspect.rs: Exposes the solve module's proof-tree inspection API by re-exporting the upstream next-solver inspect types together with this crate's analysis and visitor extensions. compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/solve/inspect/analyse.rs: Builds the proof-tree analysis layer over next-solver evaluations, turning raw proof-tree data into inspectable goals and candidates, reconstructing nested obligations and selected impl arguments, hiding solver-internal normalization details, and providing the visitor API used by selection and diagnostics to traverse proof trees. compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/solve/normalize.rs: Provides deep alias normalization on top of the new trait solver by folding through types and consts, generating alias-relation and normalizes-to obligations, managing binder placeholders and recursion limits, and offering a diagnostics-oriented variant that normalizes opportunistically without surfacing solver errors. compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/solve/select.rs: Implements trait selection on top of proof-tree inspection for the new solver, visiting a goal's candidates, applying limited winnowing and specialization preferences, and converting the chosen inspected candidate into the legacy `Selection`/`ImplSource` form with instantiated nested obligations.
